title: Prime Minister Shares glimpses of his address during the release of Autobiography of Former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared glimpses of his address during the release of the autobiography of former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind, titled ‘Triumph of the Indian Republic: My Life, My Struggles’. Emphasizing the core themes of the book, he noted that it wonderfully highlights Shri Kovind Ji’s inspiring struggles, rich contributions across various roles, and his deep commitment to public service, which stands as an inspiration for every Indian and reflects the true strengths of the nation's democracy.
In a series of posts on X, the Prime Minister shared:
"Delighted to be a part of the release of former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji’s autobiography, ‘Triumph of the Indian Republic: My Life, My Struggles.’ This book reflects the true strengths and possibilities of Indian democracy."
Delighted to be a part of the release of former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji’s autobiography, ‘Triumph of the Indian Republic: My Life, My Struggles.’ This book reflects the true strengths and possibilities of Indian democracy. @ramnathkovind pic.twitter.com/6Uqn3gYBiv — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 12, 2026
"The book by former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji is an inspiring read, wonderfully highlighting his struggles, service and rich contribution as MP, Governor and the President of India."
The book by former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji is an inspiring read, wonderfully highlighting his struggles, service and rich contribution as MP, Governor and the President of India. @ramnathkovind pic.twitter.com/kSOOASCjgV — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 12, 2026
"Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji chose public service as the path of his life and remained deeply committed to his duties throughout. His dedication and spirit of service are an inspiration for every Indian.
Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji chose public service as the path of his life and remained deeply committed to his duties throughout. His dedication and spirit of service are an inspiration for every Indian. @ramnathkovind pic.twitter.com/FtLIYUDaV9 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 12, 2026

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended and shared reflections on the release of former President Ram Nath Kovind's autobiography, titled 'Triumph of the Indian Republic: My Life, My Struggles'. In posts on X, Modi praised the book for highlighting Kovind's personal struggles and his service as an MP, Governor, and President, calling it an inspiration reflecting the strengths of Indian democracy.
enrichment.context:
Ram Nath Kovind served as the 14th President of India from 2017 to 2022, having earlier held positions as a Member of Parliament (Rajya Sabha) and as Governor of Bihar. His life story, rising from humble beginnings to the highest constitutional office, is often cited as an example of social mobility within India's democratic and constitutional framework. Book releases and memoirs by former holders of high constitutional offices periodically feature in current affairs coverage as they touch upon India's political history, constitutional posts, and the functioning of institutions like the Presidency and Governorship.

While this event is largely ceremonial, awareness of the roles and constitutional position of the President and Governors is relevant background knowledge for aspirants, particularly regarding Article 52-78 (President) and Article 153-167 (Governor) of the Constitution.

prelims_questions.explanation: Ram Nath Kovind served as the Governor of Bihar before being elected President of India in 2017.
